text: Can AI help the next doctor understand a long hospital stay? A Stony Brook study compared discharge summaries for sixty stays lasting seven to twenty-one days. Clinician reviewers preferred the AI summaries in ninety-five percent of encounters. They found fewer omissions, but estimated harm measures did not improve significantly. The review was retrospective, from one hospital, and reviewers knew which summaries were AI generated. Patient outcomes were not tested. These results support further study of clearer handoffs, with clinicians checking the content. The study was published on October second. Follow for more science.
